messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: Incident 1822509876 detected — elevated p99 latency on /v1/generate (hosted). Paging @oncall-sre.
Amanda Lee: acked, joining. seeing alert spikes from 17:12 UTC, p95 ~420ms -> p99 ~2.2s. Customers reporting streaming stalls.
Josh Carter: jumping in — any recent deploys around 17:00? release bot shows canary deploy at 16:58 to runtime v2.3.1 but it was a config-only change (template cache tweak).
Priyanka Rao: I rolled out a prompt-template change to the JSON-mode serializer earlier today (15:45). It adjusted how tool schema fields are expanded into templates. Reverting now to test.
Marco SRE: checking infra — GPU pools healthy, no OOMs. Network egress normal. Tail latencies concentrated on requests with large tool schemas and long prompt expansions.
Ben Kim: on the ML side, I see KV cache hit rates drop for these sessions. When prompt length grows we end up with bigger preproc tokenization work and blocking serialization before streaming starts.
Lina Gomez: customer support queue has two escalations mentioning streaming stops at ~3-4s mark, then partial response. They tried re-requesting streaming and got full response second time.
Amanda Lee: adding traces — /v1/generate spans show 'preproc:tokenize' taking 600-1500ms on problematic traces, then 'stream:init' delayed until post-preproc. p99 of stream-init = 2.1s.
Josh Carter: hypothesis: new prompt-template expansion + JSON-mode extra escaping causes super-linear tokenization cost for tool schemas. We should toggle JSON-mode off for affected runtime pool as mitigation.
Priyanka Rao: rolling back prompt-template change to previous commit now (revert PR #4821). Patch applied to staging at 17:26, will push to canary in 5.
Marco SRE: while rollback is in flight, I can apply a routing rule to send requests with header X-Prefer:fast to the older model variant (v2.2.x) and set a temporary rate-limit for large templates. Applying now.
Incident Bot: Change request 1822509876/ctx-routing created by Marco SRE. Status: in-progress.
Ben Kim: quick config to reduce preproc batching timer helps — decrease preproc_wait_ms from 20 -> 5 on canary. That reduces aggregation of huge templates into single tokenization job.
Amanda Lee: implemented preproc_wait_ms change on canary, results: median preproc down ~30% for test set. P99 still high until rollback completes.
Josh Carter: I suggest also adding a short-circuit for JSON-mode: if serialized template length > 12k chars, mark as non-streaming fallback and use buffered generation (so we don't start streaming until preproc finishes), preventing partial stalls.
Priyanka Rao: implementing short-circuit in serializer and deploying to canary now. Patch: ```diff
- if (jsonMode) serialize(schema)
+ if (jsonMode) { s = serialize(schema); if (s.length > 12000) disableStreaming = true; }
```
Marco SRE: routing change propagated. Traffic shifted ~18% off affected pool to older variant. Downstream customer impact: degraded throughput but improves tail latency.
Lina Gomez: notifying impacted customers in the high-priority queue with a short blurb: "We're investigating intermittent streaming stalls on long-tool-schema prompts; workarounds include using compact schemas or disabling JSON mode." Sending now.
Claire N.: thanks team — please capture affected customers list and severity. Also start an incident severity call if we can't get p99 under 700ms in 30m.
Amanda Lee: rollback completed at 17:43, canary metrics show p99 dropping from 2.2s -> 850ms. After routing shift and serializer short-circuit, p99 ~550ms across canary.
Ben Kim: re-evaluating KV cache behavior — cache hit% recovers once preproc latency drops. Looks like earlier we had cache thrash due to parallel tokenization jobs for same prompt variants.
Josh Carter: mitigation checklist: 1) rollback template change (done), 2) apply serializer short-circuit (done on canary), 3) lower preproc batching timer (done), 4) routing to older variant (in progress), 5) monitor for 30m.
Marco SRE: promoting fixes to prod now with gradual rollout (10% -> 50% -> 100%) and monitor. Watchlist: p95, p99, stream-init latency, CPU on preproc workers.
Incident Bot: Incident 1822509876 status -> mitigated. Postmortem task created: ENG-INC-712. Assigned to Priyanka Rao.
Priyanka Rao: I'll own postmortem and long-term fix. Initial follow-ups: rework template serializer to stream-serialize instead of building big strings; add guards in JSON-mode; add e2e tests for large tool schemas.
Claire N.: assign customer impact assessment to Lina + product for outreach. Capture SLO breach window: 17:12 - 17:55 UTC. We'll offer credits if any enterprise customers hit >5% error/latency SLA.
Lina Gomez: collecting impacted tenant IDs now and drafting messages. ETA 45m.
Amanda Lee: logging notes: example trace id 0b7f-9a3b shows preproc=1.5s, tokenize=1.1s, stream-init=1.4s, first-chunk=400ms. Attaching to postmortem.
Josh Carter: follow-up engineering tasks: implement streaming-friendly serialize, add stat for serialized-template-size distribution, circuit-breaker for >X chars, and add perf tests for JSON-mode on representative schemas.
Marco SRE: oncall handoff — I'm leaving at 18:30 UTC, handing over to oncall-sre for overnight: state is mitigated, prod rolling to 100%, watch until 19:30 then reduce paging thresholds.
oncall-sre: taking over. I'll keep pages to P1 if p99 > 1s or new customer escalations arrive. Thanks Marco.
Amanda Lee: closing thread for now, keep updates in incident runbook ENG-INC-712. :white_check_mark:
